title: A native cross-host mailbox send through the TermAl CLI in a Codex command cell never returned, delivery unknown (S3 step 2)
outcome: A cross-host mailbox send with an ~11 KiB body, issued by an agent through the supported transports, either returns a receipt or fails with a typed error within a bounded time; the layer that stalled on 2026-10-20 is named.
acceptance: A reproduction or a recorded diagnosis localizes the stall to a named layer: the Codex exec cell or tool bridge, the PowerShell inline argument passing, the TermAl CLI, or the host's cross-host send path.

If the stall is in TermAl (the CLI or the host send path), a fix makes a send with an 11 KiB inline body either return a receipt or fail with a typed error within a bounded time, and a test covers it; if the stall is outside TermAl, the item records the external cause and the supported send form (for example --message-file or the MCP tool) in docs.
